root_cause: The focused test called selectEligibleFillSelector immediately after render. VaultView's usePanelFill initializes its snapshot as loading and sets the ready snapshot only after an asynchronous panel-status message. The selector correctly returns null while its three enabled Fill rows are absent. A dynamic import between render and assertion accidentally supplied enough time in local runs; it is not a readiness contract.
